reuse.why: Adds shared assert/find/release helpers and reuses the Akahu balance branch for Fintegra, but the Fintegra link and download functions are copies and releaseLinks re-writes unlinkAccount's field clearing instead of reusing it.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a sixth copy of the link body, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, releaseLinks copies unlinkAccount's update block, and the assert/release prologue and epilogue are pasted into every link function.

placement.why: Guards and release logic live in accounts/app.ts inside the link functions, and the provider plumbing (server config, sync dispatch, types) is added where the other providers' is.

scope.why: Confined to linking, the new provider plumbing and a release note.

maintainability.why: Akahu and Enable Banking skip assertNotLinkedElsewhere and call findLinkedElsewhere only when replacing, so the shared rule is applied inconsistently across providers, and each new provider must copy the full prologue/epilogue.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount use findLinkedElsewhere directly instead of assertNotLinkedElsewhere; releaseLinks bypasses unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (link body, download function, unlink field list) are near-verbatim, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere gains replaceExistingLink; linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount bypass it via findLinkedElsewhere, and releaseLinks bypasses unlinkAccount.
